gap_analysis.objective: Run a 10-round public-goods game with endowment withdrawal after round 5, observe how five LLM participants adapt contributions from savings, and compare recorded behavior against closed-form references.

requirement.description: Ten simultaneous rounds with one contribution per participant per round.
constraints: one action per actor per round

decisions.reason: simultaneous.v1 decides all actors each round before joint commitment and its rounds parameter matches the 10-round horizon.

requirement.description: Neutral live LLM contribution choices with a recorded rationale each.

decisions.reason: llm.v1 carries the neutral instructions and personas with required observation fields and records a rationale per decision; scripted.v1 gives deterministic offline stand-ins for acceptance.

requirement.description: Withdrawal schedule, saved balances and linear pool payout with budget legality.

decisions.reason: No approved mechanism matches: recording.v1 has no payoffs and normal-form/Bertrand/Stackelberg rules differ. A Mechanism extension implements the schedule, balances and payout.

requirement.description: Scalar contribution payload for the public-goods mechanism contract.

decisions.reason: A named contribution payload with a nonnegative constraint gives the mechanism an exact registry-checked contract and retryable provider-side guardrails; generic number.v1 lacks the domain field.

requirement.description: Closed-form self-interested and cooperative reference trajectories.

decisions.reason: Point references are plain utilities, not solver searches: marginal private-return arithmetic plus zero-contribution and full-reinvestment trajectories with hand-derived oracles.

requirement.description: Allowlisted public rules/history plus own-memory-only private state.

decisions.reason: Trusted observe() allowlists plus simultaneous batching compose the privacy property: public rules, history and balances for all, own memory only, and no visibility into uncommitted simultaneous choices.

requirement.description: Five-section explanatory report with an offline pre-execution preview.

decisions.reason: Generic explanatory writers render the report and preview; domain code supplies only narrative, references and figures.

components.purpose: Saved-balance public-goods rules: withdrawal schedule, budget legality, linear pool payout and public history.

acceptance_tests.name: test_mechanism_requires_joint_actions
acceptance_tests.expected: requires_joint_actions is True and non-joint schedules are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Framework joint-batch contract; simultaneous protocol composes only with joint mechanisms.

acceptance_tests.name: test_mechanism_action_schema_contract
acceptance_tests.expected: Every actor maps exactly {contribute: ContributionPayload}.
acceptance_tests.reference: Registry payload equivalence between mechanism contract and registered schema.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_config_accepts_experiment_parameters
acceptance_tests.expected: The five-user-parameter configuration validates with zero opening balances.
acceptance_tests.reference: Supplied inputs: N=5, rounds=10, endowed=5, endowment=20, multiplier=2.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_config_rejects_shape_mismatch
acceptance_tests.expected: Mismatched N, endowed>rounds, nonpositive rounds, N<2, unknown fields and nonzero openings are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Parameter contract: group game with endowed_rounds within horizon and zero start.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_config_rejects_negative_values
acceptance_tests.expected: Negative or nonfinite endowment/multiplier are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Nonnegative finite economic parameters.

acceptance_tests.name: test_hand_derived_round_payoffs
acceptance_tests.expected: Contributions [20,10,0,5,15] yield payoffs [20,30,40,35,25] with total 50 and payout 20.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic: payoff = 20 - c + 2*50/5.

acceptance_tests.name: test_wealth_identity_hand_case
acceptance_tests.expected: Closing wealth 150 equals opening 0 plus 100 plus (2-1)*50.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic on the same profile.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_actions_rejects_over_budget
acceptance_tests.expected: Contributions above saved balance plus round endowment are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Budget rule with available funds 20 in round 1.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_actions_rejects_negative_and_nonfinite
acceptance_tests.expected: Negative, boolean, string and nonfinite contributions are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Finite nonnegative contribution domain.

acceptance_tests.name: test_validate_actions_rejects_partial_batch
acceptance_tests.expected: Partial, duplicated, wrong-kind or unknown-actor batches are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: One joint contribute action per actor.

acceptance_tests.name: test_large_and_all_in_contributions_legal
acceptance_tests.expected: Contributions of 30 and all-in 100 from savings are legal with closings 130 and 200.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic from 80 saved plus 20 endowment.

acceptance_tests.name: test_post_withdrawal_saved_fund_contribution
acceptance_tests.expected: Round-6 contributions of 25 from 200 saved are legal (closing 225); 500 is rejected; zero is legal.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic with zero endowment after withdrawal.

acceptance_tests.name: test_poor_strategy_remains_legal
acceptance_tests.expected: All-in unilateral contribution is accepted despite a negative round payoff.
acceptance_tests.reference: Legality covers strategy, not profitability: closing 40 after payoff -40.

acceptance_tests.name: test_five_six_round_boundary
acceptance_tests.expected: Round 5 carries endowment 20 and round 6 carries 0 with round==tick+1 throughout.
acceptance_tests.reference: Withdrawal schedule with six driven rounds of 10.

acceptance_tests.name: test_no_double_counting_across_rounds
acceptance_tests.expected: Balances equal cumulative payoffs and history matches outcomes over two rounds.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic: closings [50,60,70,65,55] after the second round.

acceptance_tests.name: test_observation_privacy_and_memory
acceptance_tests.expected: Observations expose only allowlisted public fields plus own memory with memory-writable, budget-locked permissions.
acceptance_tests.reference: Trusted observe() allowlists and simultaneous hidden-batch structure.

acceptance_tests.name: test_parameter_variations
acceptance_tests.expected: Varied N, horizons, withdrawal timings, endowments and multipliers run with the wealth identity.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand-checked schedule edges: never-endowed and always-endowed horizons.

acceptance_tests.name: test_offline_scripted_run
acceptance_tests.expected: A scripted offline run completes with the wealth identity, rationales and writable memory.
acceptance_tests.reference: Deterministic composition of mechanism, protocol and scripted policies.

acceptance_tests.name: test_preview_generator_offline
acceptance_tests.expected: Preview renders from configuration alone and leaves observed results pending.
acceptance_tests.reference: Offline preview contract without actor calls.

acceptance_tests.name: test_final_generator_binds_recorded_result
acceptance_tests.expected: Final report binds the recorded result with references, withdrawal-marked trajectories and interpretation from data.
acceptance_tests.reference: Recorded scripted run with N=3, rounds=4, withdrawal after round 2.

components.purpose: Scalar contribution payload contract for the public-goods mechanism.

acceptance_tests.name: test_contribution_payload_accepts_valid
acceptance_tests.expected: Nonnegative int and float contributions validate.
acceptance_tests.reference: Scalar payload domain including zero.

acceptance_tests.name: test_contribution_payload_rejects_negative
acceptance_tests.expected: Negative and NaN contributions fail payload validation.
acceptance_tests.reference: Nonnegative finite payload domain.

components.purpose: Marginal private return multiplier/N with stated one-round scope.

acceptance_tests.name: test_marginal_private_return_value
acceptance_tests.expected: Marginal return equals 0.4 for multiplier 2 and N=5.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic 2/5 with one-round scope.

acceptance_tests.name: test_marginal_private_return_rejects_bad_inputs
acceptance_tests.expected: Nonpositive N and negative/nonfinite multipliers are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Positive group size and finite nonnegative multiplier.

components.purpose: Self-interested zero-contribution trajectory for the known finite-horizon textbook setting.

acceptance_tests.name: test_zero_trajectory_hand_values
acceptance_tests.expected: Ten-round zero trajectory ends at 100 per participant and 500 group wealth.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic: 20 per endowed round, 0 after.

acceptance_tests.name: test_zero_trajectory_varied_params
acceptance_tests.expected: A 4-round N=3 case ends at 20/60 with a never-endowed zero case.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic with shortened horizon.

components.purpose: Full-reinvestment group-wealth trajectory as the cooperative reference for multiplier>1.

acceptance_tests.name: test_full_reinvestment_hand_values
acceptance_tests.expected: Full reinvestment ends at 39680 per participant and 198400 group wealth.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic: closing doubles available funds each round.

acceptance_tests.name: test_full_reinvestment_neutral_multiplier
acceptance_tests.expected: With multiplier 1 the trajectory equals cumulative endowments.
acceptance_tests.reference: Hand arithmetic: no wealth creation at multiplier 1.

acceptance_tests.name: test_full_reinvestment_rejects_bad_inputs
acceptance_tests.expected: Bad horizons, negative funds and nonpositive N are rejected.
acceptance_tests.reference: Finite horizon and nonnegative parameter domain.
